topic: Greetings, Self-Introduction & Sound Master (TH, P vs B)
learning_objective: Enable Afaan Oromoo children to introduce themselves using Subject-Verb-Object (SVO) sentence structures while mastering the unvoiced dental fricative /θ/ and distinguishing voiceless /p/ from voiced /b/ in everyday speech.
afaan_oromoo_intro_script: Akkam bultani ijoollee jaallatamoo! Har'a Barsiisaa Caalaa wajjin sagaleewwan haaraa Afaan Ingilizii kan akka 'TH' fi 'P' akkasumas himoota gaggabaaboo of baruuf gargaaran shaakaluuf jirra. Qophooftanii? Gurra keessan naaf kennaa!

voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Barsiisaa Caalaa dhaggeeffadhaa. Arraba kee ilkaan gidduu muraasa baasiitii 'This' jedhii duukaa deebisi: 'This is my pen.'

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Arraba kee ilkaan kee jala kaa'i. 'Dis' ykn 'Zis' hin jedhinaa, kokkeen kee akka hollatu godhii 'This' jedhi!
Hidhii kee lamaan cufii qilleensa dhoosi: 'P-P-Pen'. Akka 'Ben' jedhutti hin dubbisinaa!

voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Amma immoo fakkii simbirootaa ilaalaa. Sagalee 'TH' laafaa fayyadamuudhaan duukaa jedhaa: 'I see three birds.'

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Arraba kee ilkaan gubbaafi gadii gidduu muraasa baasiiti qilleensa qofa baasi. 'Tree' jechuu irraa of eeggadhu, 'Three' jedhi!

voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Hidhii kee dhiibitee qilleensa baasuun 'Pat' jedhi. Adurree sana qaqqabna: 'Pat the cute cat.'

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: 'P' yeroo jettu qilleensi harka kee dura yoo keesse akka si rukutu ta'uu qaba. 'Bat' irraa adda baasi!
Qubee 'C' akka Afaan Oromoo 'Caaltuu' miti; Afaan Ingilizii keessatti akka 'K' laafaatti sagaleessi: 'Cat'!

voice_exercises.app_character_audio_script: Hello! My name is Caaltuu. What is your name?
voice_exercises.afaan_oromoo_instruction_script: Caaltuun of ibsaa jirti. Maqaa kee itti dabaltee: 'My name is...' jedhii maaykiroofoonitti dubbadhu!

trouble_phonemes.afaan_oromoo_tip: Afaan Oromoo keessatti 'Maqaan koo Caaltuudha' (Maqaa + dha) jenna. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti garuu 'My name is...' jedhama. 'Is' dursee dhufa!
